translations.web: Harness the horses, and get up, you horsemen, and stand up with your helmets. Polish the spears, put on the coats of mail.
translations.bsb: Harness the horses; mount the steeds; take your positions with helmets on! Polish your spears; put on armor!
translations.kjv: Harness the horses; and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.
translations.asv: Harness the horses, and get up, ye horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, put on the coats of mail.
